bias.en: Pullback · rejected at $388, back under the averages
bias.zh: 回调 · 在 $388 受阻，重回均线下方

read.en: Tesla fell 2.4% on Nov 19 to $374.41, trading $370.81–393.60 on light volume (0.68x the 20-day average). It slipped back under the tight cluster of the 5-day ($381.6, rising), 10-day ($381.3, falling), 30-day ($381.5, rising) and 200-day ($381.9, falling), holding above the 100-day ($365.9). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 12 ($349.20), and RSI is 47.2.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月19日下跌 2.4%，收于 $374.41，盘中区间 $370.81–393.60，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.68 倍）。股价重新跌破密集的 5 日（$381.6，上行）、10 日（$381.3，下行）、30 日（$381.5，上行）和 200 日均线（$381.9，下行），守在 100 日均线（$365.9）上方。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月12日起看多（$349.20），RSI 为 47.2。

read.en: The $393.60 high broke above the $388 cap intraday but reversed, and the close lost the $378–382.8 support (averages, Nov 18 low), now resistance, holding just above the Nov 17 low ($374.13). Resistance is $378–382.8, then $388–393.6 and $397.5–401.2. Support is $370.4–370.8 (Nov 10 and 19 lows), then $365.3–365.9 (100-day, Oct 23 low) and $360. A close above $382.8 would target $388–393.6; below $370.4, $365–366.
